messages.subject: Re: Warning message
parts:
On 07/24/2014 05:18 PM, aleksandra...@hotmail.com wrote:
> Does anyone know what this means and how to fix this?

It means that the sample covariance matrix (of your data) in groups 1,
2, 3 and 4 can not be inverted. Perhaps one of the variables is a
function of other variables?

> I have more than 16000 observations and Lavaan does manage to give me
> all the output that I need.

lavaan will have used 'ridging': it has added a small value to the
diagonal of the observed sample covariance matrix, and this seemed to
have done the trick.

But you should still find out why the original input covariance matrix
of your data is not of full rank.

Yves.
